builds.toolchain: rustc 1.95.0 (59807616e 2026-04-14) for every binary: the repository pin, selected with RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.95.0 for the probe (built outside the repository tree) and by rust-toolchain.toml for the harness.
builds.probe: cd probe/manifests/{before|after} (dependency paths point at the arm source tree) && RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.95.0 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<arm target>/probe CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=6 RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=<arm source tree>=/litchi --remap-path-prefix=<probe dir>=/probe" cargo build --release --locked --offline --bins (profile release, debug=1). Only the before arm's very first build ran without --locked, to derive the probe lockfile from the repository lock; every measured binary of both arms was built --locked against that one lockfile, from the same probe source.
builds.harness: cd <arm source tree> && RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.95.0 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<arm target>/harness CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=6 cargo build --release --locked --offline --manifest-path tools/perf-baseline/Cargo.toml --bin litchi-perf-baseline (no RUSTFLAGS, no features; identical for both arms; a repeated build compiled nothing in either arm)
builds.profiling_only: probe with RUSTFLAGS additionally carrying -C force-frame-pointers=yes, for perf record --call-graph fp; never used for timing
